objective_pt: Puxar e manter conversa leve com colegas (fim de semana, projetos, planos), usar perguntas de acompanhamento e encerrar a conversa com naturalidade ("Anyway, I'd better get back to work").

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer com as perguntas mais comuns de corredor e de começo de reunião.
watchFor: Responder "How are you?" com um relato longo; no small talk a resposta é curta e devolve a pergunta.
Dizer "How was your weekend? — Was good"; falta o sujeito: "It was good".

exercises.prompt: Hey, how was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
accepted: Hey, how was your weekend? Did you do anything fun
How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que foi tranquilo, que você descansou, e devolva a pergunta.
accepted: It was quiet. I just relaxed. How about you
It was nice and quiet. I just relaxed. What about you
Pretty quiet. I just rested. How about yours
It was relaxing, thanks. How was yours
It was good, I just relaxed. And you
Quiet, I just stayed home and relaxed. How about you
It was pretty chill. I just relaxed. How was yours

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a frase precisa de sujeito: "It was quiet", e não só "Was quiet".
commonErrors.correction_en: It was quiet. I just relaxed. How about you?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tranquilo" para um fim de semana fica natural como "quiet" ou "relaxing". "Calm" e "tranquil" soam estranhos aqui.
commonErrors.correction_en: It was quiet. I just relaxed. How about you?

exercises.instruction_pt: Um colega pergunta "How's it going?". Qual é a resposta mais natural?
exercises.explanation_pt: "How's it going?" é um "tudo bem?". A resposta é curta, e você devolve: "Pretty good, thanks. You?".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões de small talk no trabalho.
prompts: Got any plans for the holiday?
watchFor: Usar "I'm full of work"; o natural é "I'm swamped" ou "I'm really busy".
Dizer "Let's take a coffee"; é "Let's grab a coffee".

exercises.example_en: We should grab lunch and catch up sometime.
Do you want to grab a coffee after the meeting?

exercises.meaning_pt: Enfim (para mudar de assunto ou encerrar)
exercises.example_en: Anyway, I'd better get back to work. See you later!

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Estou atolado de trabalho esta semana."
accepted: I'm swamped this week
I am swamped this week
I'm swamped with work this week
I'm really busy this week
I've got a lot of work this week
I have a lot of work this week
I'm snowed under this week

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cheio de trabalho" é tradução literal. O natural é "I'm swamped" ou "I'm really busy".

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar as reduções da fala informal: "How's it going", "Did you" (didja), "Want to" (wanna).
prompts: Say "Did you" fast. Does it sound like "didja"?
Say "How's it going?" as one word.
watchFor: Separar cada palavra com força igual; no inglês falado elas se ligam.
Usar "wanna" por escrito em e-mail formal; é só fala informal.

exercises.prompt: Hey! How's it going? Did you have a good trip?
accepted: Hey! How's it going? Did you have a good trip
Hey! How is it going? Did you have a good trip

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Want to" vira "wanna" na fala informal.
exercises.prompt: Do you want to grab lunch later?
accepted: Do you want to grab lunch later
Do you wanna grab lunch later
You wanna grab lunch later

exercises.instruction_pt: Como "Did you" costuma soar na fala rápida?
exercises.explanation_pt: O "d" + "y" se juntam e viram "dj": "Did you" soa como "didja".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender comentários leves de colegas e responder mantendo a conversa.
prompts: Did you see the game last night?
Any plans for the long weekend?
watchFor: Responder só "Yes" ou "No"; ensine a acrescentar um detalhe e uma pergunta.
Usar "I will travel" para plano já combinado; o natural é "I'm going to" ou "I'm traveling".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha por que a colega está cansada.
exercises.listen: Sorry, I'm a bit slow today. We had a deadline yesterday, and I was here until ten.
options: Ela foi a uma festa até as dez.
Ela ficou no trabalho até as dez por causa de um prazo.
exercises.explanation_pt: "We had a deadline" = tínhamos um prazo; "I was here until ten" = fiquei aqui até as dez.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que vai visitar a família no interior.
exercises.listen: Have you got any plans for the long weekend?
accepted: I'm going to visit my family in the countryside
I'm visiting my family in the countryside
I'm going to see my family in the countryside
Yes, I'm going to visit my family in the countryside
I'm going to visit my family. They live in the countryside
Yeah, I'm visiting my parents in the countryside
I'm going to visit my family upstate

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O interior" (fora da capital) é "the countryside" ou "a small town". "The interior" soa como o lado de dentro de algo.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm going to visit my family in the countryside.
I'm going to visit my family in the countryside.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e encerre a conversa com educação: diga que precisa voltar ao trabalho.
exercises.listen: And then we went to this amazing little restaurant by the beach...
accepted: Sounds great! Anyway, I'd better get back to work
That sounds amazing. Anyway, I'd better get back to work
Sounds lovely! I'd better get back to work, though
Anyway, I should get back to work
Anyway, I'd better get back to work. Talk later
That sounds great. I need to get back to work now
Nice! Anyway, I'd better get going

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Voltar ao trabalho" é "get back to work", sem "the".
commonErrors.correction_en: Anyway, I'd better get back to work.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o "to": "I need to go" ou "I have to go".
commonErrors.correction_en: Anyway, I'd better get back to work.

teacher.goal_pt: Manter um small talk de 2 a 3 minutos: abrir, fazer perguntas de acompanhamento e encerrar.
prompts: How's your week going so far?
What are you working on at the moment?
Have you been on vacation this year?
watchFor: Encerrar de forma brusca ("Bye"); ensine "Anyway, it was nice catching up!".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Em que você está trabalhando agora?"
accepted: What are you working on right now
What are you working on at the moment
What are you working on now
What are you working on these days
What're you working on right now
What projects are you working on right now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em perguntas com "what", a preposição vai para o final: "What are you working on?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What are you working on right now?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para projetos e tarefas, use "work on": "What are you working on?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What are you working on right now?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Foi bom colocar o papo em dia!"
accepted: It was nice catching up
It was good catching up
It was great catching up
It was nice to catch up
It was great to catch up
Nice catching up
Good catching up with you
It was nice catching up with you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Colocar o papo em dia" é "catch up". A tradução literal não funciona em inglês.
Falta o sujeito: "It was nice catching up".

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: How's your week going so far?

exercises.instruction_pt: Faça um small talk com um colega na copa do escritório.
exercises.prompt_en: You meet a coworker in the kitchen on Monday morning. Start a conversation, keep it going for a minute, and end it politely.
guidelines_pt: Abra com uma pergunta leve: "Hey! How was your weekend?".
Faça pelo menos duas perguntas de acompanhamento: "Oh really? Where did you go?", "How was it?".
Encerre com naturalidade: "Anyway, I'd better get back to work. Nice catching up!".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar as perguntas de acompanhamento, "work on" e as formas de encerrar.

exercises.prompt: Long time no see! What have you been up to?
accepted: Long time no see! What have you been up to

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Vamos tomar um café depois da reunião?"
accepted: Do you want to grab a coffee after the meeting
Want to grab a coffee after the meeting
Shall we grab a coffee after the meeting
Let's grab a coffee after the meeting
How about a coffee after the meeting
Do you want to get a coffee after the meeting
Should we grab a coffee after the meeting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tomar um café" é "have a coffee" ou "grab a coffee", e não "take a coffee".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to grab a coffee after the meeting?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vamos...?" como convite é "Let's..." ou "Do you want to...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to grab a coffee after the meeting?

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual é a melhor forma de encerrar uma conversa com um colega?
options: Anyway, I'd better get back to work. See you later!
exercises.explanation_pt: "Anyway" sinaliza que a conversa está acabando, e "I'd better get back to work" dá um motivo educado.

exercises.sentence: I'm working ___ a new project for a client in Chile.
accepted: on

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para projetos e tarefas, use "work on".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm working on a new project for a client in Chile.
